premises.text: Circling for parking causes a large share of urban traffic congestion
premises.evidence_span: half of the traffic in Brooklyn is actually caused by people circling for a parking spot

premises.text: A smartphone social network matches departing drivers' spots to seekers who can reserve them
premises.evidence_span: with Curve Karma, Marissa can find and reserve Heather's parking spot

premises.text: Karma Credits worth $1 settle each reservation: seeker pays two, giver earns one, platform keeps one
premises.evidence_span: Marissa needs two Karma Credits to reserve a spot. When Heather gives her spot to Marissa, she earns one of those Karma credits worth a dollar

premises.text: Leavers publish exact spot location via map pin, scroll, or address search
premises.evidence_span: Using the map feature, she can pinpoint exactly where she parked her car

premises.text: Built-in messaging and GPS navigation complete the handoff without revealing personal contacts
premises.evidence_span: Heather and Marissa can stay in touch using built-in messaging without revealing any personal contact information

premises.text: High-demand curb spots concentrate exchange value in cities
premises.evidence_span: only about 50,000 of those are considered in high demand

premises.text: The platform monetizes by earning one Karma Credit per completed exchange
premises.evidence_span: because Curb Karma earns a Karma credit for every exchange, we make $400,000 a year in revenue

value.text: Drivers find parking where and when they need it without circling
value.evidence_span: Curb Karma finds you parking where and when you need it

causal_links.evidence_span: end that madness and to disrupt parking
Marissa can find and reserve Heather's parking spot

notes: Free promo credits and App Store download CTA excluded as marketing. City revenue projections treated as illustrations of the per-exchange take-rate mechanism (P7), not as traction boasts. Three domains justified: scarcity diagnosis, matching product, and credit settlement are separately revisable.
